The diagonal elements $C_{ii}$ represent the variance of the $i$-th parameter, and off-diagonal elements $C_{ij}$ represent the covariance between parameters $i$ and $j$.
**Reconstruction:** Perform the 1D slice reconstruction to obtain the parameter vector $\mathbf{p}$.

**Sensitivity Analysis:** Use $\mathbf{C}$ to analyze the sensitivity of each parameter.
The standard deviation of the $i$-th parameter is $\sigma_i = \sqrt{C_{ii}}$.
High values indicate high sensitivity to noise.
